# Majal

> C# Roslyn source generator library for Domain-Driven Design (DDD) patterns and zero-overhead compile-time DTO mapping in .NET.

Majal simplifies DDD in .NET applications by automatically generating boilerplate code at compile time using Roslyn source generators. It provides clean entity identity, aggregate root domain events, generic and enum-based value objects with hash caching, soft-deletion (archivables), auditing timestamps, localized multi-language content (translatables), sequence ordering (ordinals), zero-overhead compile-time DTO projections inspired by Mapster, and first-class EF Core interceptor and convention integrations.

## Documentation

### Getting Started & Overview
- [Project Overview & Packages](/Readme.md): Introduction to Majal, core architecture, Roslyn source generator packages, build instructions, and testing.
- [Getting Started with Majal](/docs/getting-started.md): Installation via .NET CLI / NuGet, basic domain model definition, build output, and next steps.
- [AI Skill: Majal Coding Assistant](/docs/majal.skill.md): Comprehensive guidelines and common patterns for AI agents and developers implementing DDD with Majal.

### Domain-Driven Design Core Generators
- [Entities Guide](/docs/entities.md): Identity-based equality, IEntity<TId>, Id property generation, IComparable, and comparison helpers.
- [Aggregates Guide](/docs/aggregates.md): Aggregate roots, domain event lifecycle management, IAggregate<TDomainEvent>, Publish, and Clear.
- [Value Objects Guide](/docs/value-objects.md): Generic [ValueObject<T>], enum-based value objects, complex multi-property [ValueObject], equality caching, and parsing.
- [Archivables Guide (Soft-Deletion)](/docs/archivables.md): Soft-deletion metadata, IArchivable, IsArchived and ArchivedOn properties, and EF Core interceptor support.
- [Auditables Guide (Creation & Update Tracking)](/docs/auditables.md): Creation and update timestamp tracking, IAuditable<DateTimeOffset>, CreatedOn, and UpdatedOn.
- [Translatables Guide (Multi-Language Support)](/docs/translatables.md): Multi-language content management, [Translatable<TLocale>], [TranslatableOptions], and translation completeness validation.
- [Ordinals Guide (Custom Sort Order)](/docs/ordinals.md): Sequence and sort order management, IOrdinal, and Ordinal uint property.

### DTO Generation & Mapping
- [DTOs Guide (Compile-Time DTO Generation & Projections)](/docs/dtos.md): Zero-overhead compile-time forward mapping (FromEntity/Projection), reverse reconstruction (ToEntity), [DtoMember], [DtoIgnore], [DtoFlatten], polymorphism, and query expressions.

### Framework Integration & Samples
- [Entity Framework Core Integration](/docs/ef-core.md): Majal.EntityFrameworkCore package, MajalDbContext<TLocale> base class, automatic SaveChangesInterceptors, query filters, and value converters.
- [EShop Sample & Web Front-End](/samples/EShop.Web/README.md): Full-stack sample architecture exercising every Majal generator over Wolverine.Http, EF Core SQLite, and Nuxt UI.
